verdict.rationale: Semgrep exposes an AppSec Platform API for listing deployments, findings, and projects (semgrep-docs-17), and CLI/CI workflows can be automated, but core UI-only functions like writing/testing rules in the Semgrep Editor, Secrets triage comments, and SBOM/report generation aren't shown as API-accessible, and no OpenAPI/API reference was found (probe shows 404s for openapi spec). missing for 10: evidence of full API parity for rule authoring/editor, findings triage/PR comments, SBOM generation, and a public API reference/spec confirming complete UI-to-API coverage.
